items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: we had a trio, a bass, a piano and a guitar. That was like a big hot trio. Carl Senior was the piano player.

ctx.x: When we were down in the village, this is before I met any of them guys, maybe I knew Flip, but then we had a trio, a bass, a piano and a guitar. That was like a big hot trio. Carl Senior was the piano player. But Bob Rowe was the bass player. And Bob Rowe — this was down on Bleecker Street and it’s right on the corner, it’s still a bar, and a wild little place.
